answer_1.quote: Keyphrase generation methods aim at predicting both the present and absent phrases ... We evaluate SEG-Net on seven benchmarks from scientific and web documents ...

answer_2.quote: We follow Chan et al. ( ) to perform evaluation and report F1@M and F1@5 for all the baselines and our models. We measure the mean absolute error (MAE) between the number of generated keyphrases and the number of groundtruth keyphrases.
